turns.text: Hi, please, I really need your help. I'm on the 11:45 flight to Mumbai today and I can't make it.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can I have your booking code and last name to start?
Yes, it's TT5K8M, Sato. Hana Sato.
Thank you, Ms. Sato, I have your booking. What would you like to do?
Could you move me to the 21:00 flight tonight, the SK512? Please, I'm begging you.
I understand how stressful that is. But your flight leaves in under two hours, and we can't make voluntary changes that close to departure.
Please, there must be something. It's just a few hours, I'll pay whatever fee you want.
I'm really sorry, I can't override that, even with a fee. I can offer a supervisor callback if you'd like.
Okay, yes, a supervisor callback, please. Could they call me before the 11:45 leaves?
I'll request it now and note it's urgent, though I can't promise a time. Anything else I can do?
No, that's all. Thank you, I know you're trying.
Of course. To sum up, I couldn't change SK510 because it's within two hours of departure, and I've requested an urgent supervisor callback. Take care.
